summary: Return the length of the last word in a string of words separated by spaces.
mainInsight: Scan from the end: skip trailing spaces, then count characters until the next space or the start. This avoids splitting the whole string.

approaches.name: split() and take the last word

promptVariants: What common bug does the backwards scan avoid?

cards.answer: Taking the characters after the last space returns 0 when the string ends with spaces. Skipping trailing spaces first locates the real last word, and counting stops at the next space or the start of the string.

cards.explanation: At worst the whole string is scanned.

canonicalCode:
class Solution:
    def lengthOfLastWord(self, s: str) -> int:
        i = len(s) - 1
        while i >= 0 and s[i] == " ":            # skip trailing spaces
            i -= 1
        length = 0
        while i >= 0 and s[i] != " ":            # count the last word
            length += 1
            i -= 1
        return length
